أتلاعب (form VI)
# أَتَلَاعَبُ (ʔatalāʕabu) /ʔa.ta.laː.ʕa.bu/: first-person singular non-past active indicative of تَلَاعَبَ (talāʕaba)
# أَتَلَاعَبَ (ʔatalāʕaba) /ʔa.ta.laː.ʕa.ba/: first-person singular non-past active subjunctive of تَلَاعَبَ (talāʕaba)
# أَتَلَاعَبْ (ʔatalāʕab) /ʔa.ta.laː.ʕab/: first-person singular non-past active jussive of تَلَاعَبَ (talāʕaba)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
